catalog_scope: Firmware and log-format reference index; not a verified aircraft specification database.

profiles.name: ArduPilot
profiles.limitations: Parameter defaults and message definitions vary by firmware release, board target, and vehicle class.

profiles.name: PX4
profiles.limitations: ULog topic availability depends on firmware version and logger configuration.

profiles.name: Betaflight
profiles.limitations: Blackbox predictor/frame decoding requires the matching blackbox-tools decoder and version-aware validation.

profiles.name: INAV
profiles.limitations: Field definitions and frame encoding are version-dependent.

profiles.name: DJI FlightRecord
profiles.limitations: FlightRecord v13-v14 frame decryption requires per-flight keychains from DJI. Aircraft DAT is distinct from app FlightRecord TXT and is not generally decoded by the FlightRecord parser.

profiles.name: Unknown / Custom Vehicle
profiles.limitations: No model defaults are applied. The investigator must supply and document field mappings, units, frames, and geometry.
